## Event Analytics Hub

Event Analytics Hub is a platform for exploring event-driven analytics — from
core concepts to interactive dashboards.

Every blog post links to an interactive Shiny application where you can test
the concepts with real data. The gap between reading about analytics and
doing analytics shouldn't exist.

Data analytics professional focused on event-driven architectures, R, and the

## Built with

This platform is built with R, Shiny, Quarto, and Docker — deployed on a
self-hosted server with Docker Swarm and Traefik. The blog renders to static
HTML. The Shiny apps run in Docker containers. Both are open source.
